'''bmackin13 Ugloste, You Done Good''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bmackin13]]
* '''Published:''' 5 September 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Any Methods Necessary|ECC-D-anymethodsnecessary.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 CCT bmackin13 DS 2004 5819.txt |Download]] (omits Boba Fett (V), Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (V), Slave I (V), Bane Malar (V), Dengar (V), Djas Puhr (V), Greedo (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Prince Xizor (V), Zuckuss (V), Guri (V), IG-88 (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Despair (V), Jabba's Influence (V), Ket Maliss (V), Special Delivery (V), He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V), Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V), Voyeur (V), Hound's Tooth (V), Mist Hunter (V), Punishing One (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Looking for advice from experienced gamers.  i have only played friends/family, never tournaments.

(V) (VS3); Greedo (V) (VS4); Dengar (V), IG-88 (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Voyeur (V), Hound's Tooth (V), Mist Hunter (V) (VS5); Boba Fett (V), Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Despair (V), Jabba's Influence (V), Special Delivery (V), He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V) (VS6); Slave I (V), Bane Malar (V), Prince Xizor (V), Zuckuss (V), Guri (V), Punishing One (V) (VS7, dated 2004-07-19).
* Posted 'Djas Phur(v)' dested Djas Puhr (V); 'All Wraped Up' All Wrapped Up.

== Strategy ==

if you dont know how to flip quick, see my previous CCT deck.

some card strategy:

Desilijic tattoo: makes bounty hunters, especially ones with weapons, good

jabbas influence: makes BHs more powerful and lets you deploy non-BHs from reserve. also lets Palpy be used with Scum

ket maliss: can deploy DBs, can take some good people, and while Palpy's not on table, makes black sun agents(some of which are "created" with Xizor) better

special delivery: can deploy effects and makes use of Carbonite Chamber Counsle

one of my favorite combos is Jodo Kast, a naboo blaster rifle, some other random alien, hidden weapons, and Jabba's Through With You. almost garunteed hit on anyone, two battle destinies and (hopefully)a hidden weapons capture/hit/lost
